feature_compatibility_audit.shoulder_tilt_deg: Identical atan2(dy, dx) formula. MultiPosture camera roll offset (+9.59 deg) calibrated.
feature_compatibility_audit.neck_angle_deg: Identical lateral head deviation formula atan2(|dx|, -dy).
feature_compatibility_audit.head_to_shoulder_ratio: NOT AVAILABLE in PostureGuard historical data. Raw nose/shoulder coordinates were not stored in posture_data.csv. Per project integrity guidelines, head_to_shoulder_ratio was NOT fabricated or synthetic.

evaluation_scope_documentation.unseen_participants: Tested for correct, leaning_left, and leaning_right via MultiPosture test subjects ['10', '12', '13'].
evaluation_scope_documentation.unseen_sessions: Tested for slouching via PostureGuard Session 2 (same participant, unseen recording session).
evaluation_scope_documentation.cross_participant_generalization_warning: Slouching is tested ONLY on an unseen session of the SINGLE PostureGuard participant. This evaluation DOES NOT measure slouching generalization across different individuals.
